en.t: Augsburg ruling records Munich in an official document
en.s: On June 14, 1158, a ruling in Augsburg settled a dispute over an Isar crossing and its tolls in favor of Henry the Lion. The document mentioned Munich by name. The city treats this as its official founding date, although a settlement already existed there.
en.n: The date belongs to the Augsburg ruling and Munich’s first documented mention, rather than the first appearance of a settlement.

zh.t: 奥格斯堡裁决首次在正式文书中记载慕尼黑
zh.s: 1158年6月14日，奥格斯堡的一项裁决将伊萨尔河渡口及通行税争端判给狮子亨利一方。文书提到了慕尼黑的名字。慕尼黑以这一天为官方建城日，但当地此前已有聚落。
zh.n: 这一天是奥格斯堡裁决和慕尼黑首次见于正式文书的日期，并非当地聚落出现的第一天。

en.t: Prince Louis enters Winchester during the First Barons' War
en.s: Prince Louis of France entered Winchester, England, on June 14, 1216 during the First Barons' War after King John had left the city. Royalist defenders still held Winchester Castle and the fortified Wolvesey Palace; those strongholds surrendered on June 24. Louis had been invited by rebel English barons to challenge John for the crown.
en.n: Louis entered the city on June 14; Winchester Castle and Wolvesey Palace did not surrender until June 24.

zh.t: 第一次男爵战争期间，法国王子路易进入温彻斯特
zh.s: 1216年6月14日，法国王子路易在第一次男爵战争期间进入英格兰温彻斯特，此前英王约翰已离开该城。拥护约翰的守军仍控制温彻斯特城堡和设防的伍尔弗西宫，这两处据点直到6月24日才投降。路易受英格兰叛乱男爵邀请，前来争夺王位。
zh.n: 路易于6月14日进入城内；温彻斯特城堡和伍尔弗西宫直到6月24日才投降。

en.s: The Battle of Hova was fought in Hova, Sweden on 14 June 1275 between peasants commanded by Valdemar of Sweden and Danish cavalry commanded by Magnus III of Sweden and his brother Erik. The result was that Valdemar had to flee to Norway and Magnus became king of Sweden as Magnus III.

zh.s: 霍瓦战役于1275年6月14日在瑞典霍瓦爆发。交战双方是瑞典国王瓦尔德马尔指挥的农民军，以及由瑞典马格努斯三世及其兄弟埃里克指挥的丹麦骑兵。战役结果是瓦尔德马尔被迫逃往挪威，马格努斯成为瑞典国王。

en.s: The naval Battle of Ponza took place on 14 June 1300 near the islands of Ponza and Zannone, in the Gulf of Gaeta (NW of Naples), when a galley fleet commanded by Roger of Lauria defeated an Aragonese-Sicilian galley fleet commanded by Conrad d'Oria. Lauria's 40 Angevin galleys were at Naples when 32 Sicilian galleys under d'Oria arrived and challenged him to come out. For the first time he refused, probably because of a lack of confidence in his Angevin crews, and d'Oria ravaged some offshore islands. This allowed 12 Apulian galleys to arrive from the south and 7 Genoese galleys to arrive also, and join Lauria's fleet, making 59 galleys.

zh.s: 庞扎海战于1300年6月14日在盖塔湾（那不勒斯西北方向）的庞扎岛和赞诺内岛附近爆发。罗杰·德·劳里亚指挥的桨帆船舰队击败了康拉德·多里亚率领的阿拉贡—西西里舰队。劳里亚的40艘安茹桨帆船当时驻扎那不勒斯，多里亚率32艘西西里桨帆船抵达并挑战他出战。劳里亚首次拒绝迎战，可能是对安茹船员缺乏信心；多里亚随后袭扰了附近一些岛屿。这让南方赶来的12艘阿普利亚桨帆船和随后抵达的7艘热那亚桨帆船得以加入劳里亚的舰队，使其总数达到59艘。

en.s: The Peasants' Revolt, also named Wat Tyler's Rebellion or the Great Uprising, was a major uprising across large parts of England in 1381. The revolt had various causes, including the socio-economic and political tensions generated by the Black Death in the 1340s, the high taxes resulting from the conflict with France during the Hundred Years' War, and instability within the local leadership of London.
en.n: Richard II of England meets leaders of the Peasants' Revolt at Mile End. The Tower of London is stormed by rebels who enter without resistance.

zh.s: 1381年，英格兰多地爆发大规模起义，也称瓦特·泰勒起义或大起义。黑死病引发的社会经济和政治矛盾、英法百年战争带来的高额税收，以及伦敦地方领导层的不稳定，都是起义的原因。
zh.n: 1381年6月14日，理查二世在迈尔恩德与农民起义领袖会面。起义者攻入伦敦塔，没有遭到抵抗。

en.s: The Battle of Kizaki (木崎原の戦い) occurred on the 4th day of the fifth month of Genki 3 (June 14, 1572) when the forces of Shimazu Yoshihiro defeated the larger army of Itō Yoshisuke. The battle, also known as "The Okehazama of Kyushu". Following their capture of Obi Castle, the Itō strengthened their position on southern Hyūga and began encroaching on territory belonging to the Shimazu clan.

zh.s: 木崎原之战发生于元龟三年五月四日，即1572年6月14日。岛津义弘率军击败了规模更大的伊东义佑军队。这场战斗也称“九州的桶狭间”。伊东氏攻占飫肥城后，巩固了在日向南部的地位，并开始侵入岛津氏领地。

en.s: The Battle of Naseby was a decisive engagement of the English Civil War, fought on 14 June 1645 between the main Royalist army of King Charles I and the Parliamentarian New Model Army, commanded by Sir Thomas Fairfax and Oliver Cromwell. It was fought near the village of Naseby in Northamptonshire. After a disappointing performance by the Parliamentarian army at the Second Battle of Newbury at the tail end of the 1644 campaign season that failed to inflict a decisive defeat on the Royalists, Oliver Cromwell worked to push the Self-denying Ordinance through Parliament, intent on re-forming Parliament's forces into a more effective, centralised force.

zh.s: 纳斯比战役是英国内战中的决定性战役，于1645年6月14日爆发，交战双方是查理一世的王党主力军和由托马斯·费尔法克斯爵士、奥利弗·克伦威尔指挥的议会新模范军。战斗发生在北安普敦郡纳斯比村附近。1644年战役季末，议会军在第二次纽伯里战役中表现不佳，未能决定性击败王党军。此后，克伦威尔推动议会通过《自我否认条例》，希望将议会军改组为更有效、指挥更集中的军队。

en.s: The Battle of Wevelinghoven (German: Schlacht bei Wevelinghoven) or Battle of Grevenbroich (Schlacht bei Grevenbroich) was one of the final battles of the Thirty Years' War. It took place on 14 June 1648 between troops of Holy Roman Empire and of the victorious Hesse-Cassel. Several sources cite the Julian date of 4 June.

zh.s: 韦弗林霍芬战役也称格雷芬布罗赫战役，是三十年战争结束前的最后几场战斗之一。战斗于1648年6月14日爆发，交战双方是神圣罗马帝国军队和获胜的黑森-卡塞尔军队。部分资料采用儒略历，将日期记为6月4日。

en.s: The Battle of the Dunes (French: Bataille des Dunes, Spanish: Batalla de las Dunas), also known as the Battle of Dunkirk, took place on 14 June 1658, near the strategic port of Dunkirk in what was then the Spanish Netherlands. Part of the Franco-Spanish War and concurrent Anglo-Spanish War, a French army under Turenne, supported by troops from the Commonwealth of England, had besieged Dunkirk.

zh.s: 沙丘战役也称敦刻尔克战役，发生于1658年6月14日，当时敦刻尔克位于西属尼德兰。这是法西战争和英西战争期间的一场战斗。蒂雷纳子爵指挥的法军在英格兰共和国军队支援下，围攻具有战略意义的敦刻尔克港。

en.s: The Four Days' Battle was a naval engagement fought from 11 to 14 June 1666 (1–4 June O.S.) during the Second Anglo-Dutch War. It began off the Flemish coast and ended near the English coast, and remains one of the longest naval battles in history. The Royal Navy suffered significant damage, losing around twenty ships in total.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 四日海战是第二次英荷战争期间的一场海战，发生于1666年6月11日至14日（儒略历6月1日至4日）。战斗从佛兰德斯海岸附近开始，最后在英格兰海岸附近结束，是历史上持续时间最长的海战之一。英国皇家海军损失惨重，共损失约20艘舰船。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.t: The second Battle of Schooneveld is fought off the Dutch coast
en.s: On June 14, 1673, the Dutch fleet led by Michiel de Ruyter fought an Anglo-French fleet off the coast of the Netherlands in the second Battle of Schooneveld.
en.n: Date given in the Gregorian calendar; June 4 in the Julian calendar then used in England.

zh.t: 荷兰近海发生第二次斯霍讷费尔德海战
zh.s: 1673年6月14日，米希尔·德·鲁伊特率领的荷兰舰队与英法联合舰队在荷兰近海交战，史称第二次斯霍讷费尔德海战。
zh.n: 日期采用公历；当时英格兰使用的儒略历日期为6月4日。

en.s: The Battle of Bridport was fought on 14 June 1685, at the start of the Monmouth Rebellion in the town of Bridport, in Dorset, England. The battle was a victory for the Royalist forces and the rebels were forced to march to Axminster.

zh.s: 布里德波特战役于1685年6月14日在英格兰多塞特郡布里德波特镇爆发，处于蒙茅斯叛乱初期。王党军获胜，叛军被迫向阿克斯明斯特行进。

en.s: The Battle of Bloody Mose (often called the Battle of Fort Mose, or Bloody Moosa) was a significant action of the War of Jenkins' Ear that took place on June 14, 1740, in Spanish Florida. Captain Antonio Salgado commanded a Spanish column of 300 regular troops, backed by the free black militia under Francisco Menéndez and allied Seminole warriors consisting of Indian auxiliaries.

zh.s: 血腥莫塞战役也常称莫塞堡战役或血腥穆萨战役，是詹金斯耳朵战争期间的一场重要战斗，于1740年6月14日在西属佛罗里达爆发。安东尼奥·萨尔加多上尉指挥300名西班牙正规军，弗朗西斯科·梅嫩德斯率领的自由黑人民兵和盟军塞米诺尔战士（印第安辅助部队）提供支援。

en.s: The Action of 14 June 1742 was a minor naval battle of the War of the Austrian Succession in which a small British squadron under Captain Richard Norris burned 5 Spanish royal galleys at the French port of Saint Tropez. Norris had surprised the galleys near Sainte-Marguerite and had chased and driven them into the French port.

zh.s: 1742年6月14日海战是奥地利王位继承战争期间的一场小规模海战。理查德·诺里斯船长率领一支小型英国舰队，在法国圣特罗佩港焚毁5艘西班牙王家桨帆船。诺里斯此前在圣玛格丽特岛附近突袭这些船只，并一路追击，将它们逼入法国港口。

en.s: The Second Continental Congress (1775–1781) was the meeting of delegates from the Thirteen Colonies that united in support of the American Revolution and Revolutionary War, which established American independence from Great Britain. The Congress constituted a new federation that it first named the United Colonies of North America, and in 1776, renamed the United States of America.
en.n: The Second Continental Congress passes the Flag Act of 1777 adopting the Stars and Stripes as the Flag of the United States.

zh.s: 第二次大陆会议（1775—1781年）由北美十三个殖民地的代表组成，团结各殖民地支持美国革命和独立战争，并推动建立独立的美国。会议最初将新邦联称为“北美联合殖民地”，1776年改名为“美利坚合众国”。
zh.n: 1777年6月14日，第二次大陆会议通过《国旗决议》，采用由13道红白相间条纹和蓝底13颗白星组成的美国国旗。

en.t: Continental Congress adopts the Flag Resolution
en.s: On June 14, 1777, the Continental Congress adopted a flag with thirteen alternating red and white stripes and thirteen white stars on a blue field. The stars represented the thirteen states. This was an early design of the U.S. flag, rather than the fifty-star version used today.
en.n: The 1777 resolution specified thirteen stars.

zh.t: 大陆会议通过美国国旗决议
zh.s: 1777年6月14日，大陆会议通过国旗决议，规定国旗采用红白相间的13道条纹，蓝底上有13颗白星，代表当时的13个州。这是美国国旗的早期样式，与今天的50星版本不同。
zh.n: 1777年的决议规定国旗使用13颗星。

en.s: The Battle of Boruszkowce was a battle in the Polish–Russian War of 1792. The battle took place on 14 June 1792, between a detachment of a Polish army of Michał Wielhorski and a Russian army group under the command of Michail Kachovski. Main Polish forces under command of Poniatowski withdrew to Połonne across Czantoria; they were secured from the south by a division under command of Kościuszko. A Polish army train, secured by a division of Wielhorski, moved the shortest way across Boruszkowice. Wielhorski had under his command 6500 soldiers and 12 cannons.

zh.s: 博鲁什科夫采战役是1792年波俄战争中的一场战斗，于1792年6月14日爆发。波军米哈乌·维尔霍尔斯基分遣队与米哈伊尔·卡霍夫斯基指挥的俄军交战。波兰主力在波尼亚托夫斯基指挥下经赞托里亚撤往波隆内，南侧由科希丘什科指挥的师掩护。维尔霍尔斯基指挥的一支波军辎重队走最短路线，经博鲁什科维采前进。他麾下有6,500名士兵和12门火炮。

en.s: The Battle of Bascara on 14 June 1795 saw an Republican French army led by Barthélemy Louis Joseph Schérer clash with a Spanish Royal army commanded by José de Urrutia y de las Casas. While Scherer's army was on a foraging expedition, Urrutia believed that his army was under attack. The Spanish general quickly massed his troops and assaulted the French center, forcing it to withdraw. Bàscara is located 24 kilometres (15 mi) north of Girona, Spain. The fighting occurred during the War of the Pyrenees, part of the War of the First Coalition.

zh.s: 巴斯卡拉战役于1795年6月14日爆发，巴泰勒米·路易·约瑟夫·谢雷尔率领的共和法国军队与何塞·德·乌鲁蒂亚·德·拉斯卡萨斯指挥的西班牙王家军队交战。当谢雷尔的军队外出筹集粮草时，乌鲁蒂亚误以为己方正遭到攻击。西班牙将军迅速集结部队，向法军中央阵地发动进攻，迫使法军撤退。巴斯卡拉位于西班牙赫罗纳以北24公里（15英里）。战斗发生在比利牛斯战争期间，该战争是第一次反法同盟战争的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Marengo was fought on 14 June 1800 between French forces under Napoleon Bonaparte and Austrian forces near the city of Alessandria, in Piedmont, Italy. Near the end of the day, the French overcame General Michael von Melas's surprise attack, driving the Austrians out of Italy, and enhancing Napoleon's political position in Paris as First Consul of France in the wake of his coup d’état the previous November. Surprised by the Austrian advance toward Genoa in mid-April 1800, Bonaparte had hastily led his army over the Alps in mid-May and reached Milan on 2 June.

zh.s: 马伦戈战役于1800年6月14日在意大利皮埃蒙特的亚历山德里亚附近爆发，交战双方是拿破仑·波拿巴率领的法军和奥军。临近当天结束时，法军击退迈克尔·冯·梅拉斯将军的突袭，将奥军赶出意大利。这也巩固了拿破仑在前一年11月发动政变后作为法国第一执政的政治地位。1800年4月中旬，波拿巴得知奥军向热那亚推进后，匆忙率军翻越阿尔卑斯山，5月中旬抵达米兰。

en.s: The Battle of Friedland (14 June 1807) was a major engagement of the Napoleonic Wars between the armies of the French Empire and the Russian Empire, led by Napoleon I and General Levin August von Bennigsen respectively. Napoleon and the French obtained a decisive victory that routed much of the Russian army, which retreated chaotically over the Alle river by the end of the fighting.

zh.s: 弗里德兰战役发生于1807年6月14日，是拿破仑战争期间法兰西帝国与俄罗斯帝国军队之间的一场重大战役，双方分别由拿破仑一世和莱文·奥古斯特·冯·贝尼格森将军指挥。拿破仑和法军取得决定性胜利，击溃俄军大部；战斗结束时，俄军混乱地越过阿勒河撤退。

en.s: The Capture of the Rosily Squadron took place on 14 June 1808, in Cadiz, Spain, nearly three years after the Battle of Trafalgar, during the uprising against the French invaders. Five French ships of the line and a frigate were still in the port, having remained there since the British victory. French Admiral Rosily, after an engagement with the Spanish lasting five days, surrendered his entire squadron with the four thousand seamen then on board.

zh.s: 1808年6月14日，西班牙加的斯发生俘获罗西利舰队事件，距特拉法加海战近三年，当时正值西班牙起义反抗法国侵略者。港内仍有5艘法国战列舰和1艘护卫舰，自英国获胜后一直停泊在那里。法国海军上将罗西利与西班牙人交战5天后投降，交出了整支舰队及当时在舰上的4,000名水兵。

en.s: The two battles of the Bruch (Spanish: Batallas del Bruch; Catalan: Batalles del Bruc) were engagements fought successively, at El Bruc, near Barcelona, Catalonia, on 6 and 14 June 1808, during the Peninsular War, by French troops commanded by Brigadier General François de Schwarz and General of Division Joseph Chabran against Spanish volunteers and mercenaries led by General Antoni Franch i Estalella and Joan Baget.

zh.s: 两场布鲁赫战役先后于1808年6月6日和14日在半岛战争期间爆发，地点在加泰罗尼亚巴塞罗那附近的埃尔布鲁赫。交战双方是弗朗索瓦·德·施瓦茨准将和约瑟夫·沙布朗师长指挥的法军，以及安东尼·弗兰奇·埃斯塔列利亚将军和琼·巴盖特率领的西班牙志愿兵和雇佣兵。

en.s: The Battle of Raab or Battle of Győr (Hungarian: győri csata) was fought on 14 June 1809 during the Napoleonic Wars, between Franco-Italian forces and Habsburg forces. Most of the Habsburg army consisted of poorly trained Landwehr and militia. The battle was fought near Győr (Raab in German), Kingdom of Hungary, and ended in a Franco-Italian victory.

zh.s: 拉布战役也称杰尔战役，于1809年6月14日在拿破仑战争期间爆发，交战双方是法意联军和哈布斯堡军队。哈布斯堡军队大部分由训练不足的地方民兵组成。战斗发生在匈牙利王国的杰尔（德语称拉布）附近，最终法意联军获胜。

en.s: The invasion of Algiers was a large-scale military operation by which the Kingdom of France, ruled by King Charles X, invaded and conquered the Regency of Algiers. A diplomatic incident in 1827, the so-called 'Fan Affair' ('Fly Whisk Incident'), served as a pretext to initiate a blockade against the port of Algiers. After three years of standstill and a more severe incident in which a French ship carrying an ambassador to the dey with a proposal for negotiations was fired upon, the French determined that more forceful action was required. Charles X also sought to divert attention from turbulent French domestic affairs which culminated with his deposition during the later stages of the invasion in the July Revolution. The invasion began on 14 June 1830 with a naval bombardment by a fleet under Admiral Duperré and a landing by troops under Louis Auguste Victor de Ghaisne, comte de Bourmont.

zh.s: 入侵阿尔及尔是法兰西王国在查理十世统治下发动的一次大规模军事行动，最终法国入侵并征服阿尔及尔摄政区。1827年的外交事件“拂尘风波”成为法国封锁阿尔及尔港口的借口。僵持三年后，一艘载有使节、奉命向阿尔及尔统治者提出谈判方案的法国船只又遭到炮击，法国因此决定采取更强硬的行动。查理十世也希望借此转移公众对国内动荡的注意力；这些动荡最终在入侵后期引发七月革命并导致他被推翻。入侵于1830年6月14日开始，法国舰队在迪佩雷海军上将指挥下炮击海岸，路易·奥古斯特·维克托·德·盖斯纳·德·布尔蒙伯爵率军登陆。

en.s: The Spafford Farm massacre, also referred to as the Wayne massacre, was an attack upon U.S. militia and civilians that occurred as part of the Black Hawk War near present-day South Wayne, Wisconsin. Spafford Farm was settled in 1830 by Omri Spafford and his partner Francis Spencer. Before the war started they made numerous improvements to the parcel of land. On June 14, 1832 five men were attacked by a Kickapoo war party, three whites were killed instantly, including Spafford. In total at least one Native and four white settlers were killed in the action.

zh.s: 斯帕福德农场屠杀也称韦恩屠杀，是黑鹰战争期间发生在美国民兵和平民身上的一次袭击，地点靠近现今威斯康星州南韦恩。奥姆里·斯帕福德和合伙人弗朗西斯·斯宾塞于1830年在此建立农场，战前对这块土地进行了多项改造。1832年6月14日，基卡普人战士袭击了5名男子，3名白人当场死亡，其中包括斯帕福德。此次交战至少造成1名原住民和4名白人定居者死亡。

en.s: The Ingham Incident, or the Montezuma Affair, was a naval battle fought in 1835, the first between Mexico and the United States. The Mexican warship Montezuma patrolled the coast of Texas to prevent the smuggling of contraband into the territory. During the cruise, the Mexicans captured the American merchant ship Martha and later the Texan ship Columbia which led to a response by the United States Revenue-Marine revenue cutter USRC Ingham.

zh.s: 英格姆号事件又称“蒙特苏马号事件”，是1835年美国与墨西哥之间的第一次海战。墨西哥军舰“蒙特苏马”号在得克萨斯海岸巡逻，阻止违禁品走私。巡逻期间，墨西哥人扣押了美国商船“玛莎”号和得克萨斯船只“哥伦比亚”号，美国税务海上巡逻队的巡逻舰USRC Ingham随后出动应对。

en.s: Partial general elections were held in Belgium on 14 June 1859. The result was a victory for the Liberal Party, which won 69 of the 116 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 31 of the 58 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 55.9%, although only 49,672 people were eligible to vote. Under the alternating system, elections for the Chamber of Representatives were only held in five out of the nine provinces: Antwerp, Brabant, Luxembourg, Namur and West Flanders. Additionally, special elections were held on the same day in the arrondissements of Liège and Mons.

zh.s: 比利时于1859年6月14日举行部分大选。自由党获胜，在众议院116席中赢得69席，在参议院58席中赢得31席。投票率为55.9%，但只有49,672人符合投票资格。按照轮替制度，众议院选举只在九个省中的五个省举行：安特卫普、布拉班特、卢森堡、那慕尔和西佛兰德。此外，列日和蒙斯两个区同日举行了特别选举。

It ended with the defeat of the Bukhara army, and the transition of the Bukhara Emirate to vassal dependence on the Russian Empire.

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 14 June 1892, the first full general elections since 1870 and the last before the introduction of universal male suffrage prior to the 1894 elections. The result was a victory for the Catholic Party, which won 92 of the 152 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 46 of the 76 seats in the Senate. Run-off elections were held on 21 June 1892 in the arrondissements of Mons, Tournai, Verviers, Nivelles and Charleroi as no candidate received a majority there.

en.s: The arms race between Great Britain and Germany that occurred from the last decade of the nineteenth century until the advent of World War I in 1914 was one of the intertwined causes of that conflict. While based in a bilateral relationship that had worsened over many decades, the arms race began with a plan by German Admiral Alfred von Tirpitz in 1897 to create a fleet in being to force Britain to make diplomatic concessions; Tirpitz did not expect the Imperial German Navy to defeat the Royal Navy.
en.n: The second German Naval Law calls for the Imperial German Navy to be doubled in size, resulting in an Anglo-German naval arms race.

en.s: The Irish presidential election of 1945 was held on 14 June 1945. It was Ireland's first contested presidential election. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Iran on 14 June 2013. Hassan Rouhani won with a landslide victory, elected in the first round of voting with 50.88% of the vote. Tehran Mayor Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf finished second with 16.46% of the vote. Nearly 36.792 million Iranians voted, 72.77% of eligible voters. The Guardian Council screened 680 registered candidates, approving eight to run in the election; Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Gholam-Ali Haddad-Adel, Ali Akbar Velayati, Saeed Jalili, Mohsen Rezaee, Mohammad Gharazi, Hassan Rouhani and Mohammad Reza Aref. Haddad-Adel and Aref later withdrew from the race in the days leading up to the election.

zh.s: 伊朗于2013年6月14日举行总统选举。哈桑·鲁哈尼以压倒性优势获胜，首轮得票率为50.88%。德黑兰市长穆罕默德·巴盖尔·加利巴夫以16.46%得票率排名第二。近3,679.2万伊朗人参加投票，占符合资格选民的72.77%。宪法监护委员会审查了680名登记候选人，批准其中8人参选：穆罕默德·巴盖尔·加利巴夫、吴拉姆-阿里·哈达德-阿德尔、阿里·阿克巴尔·韦拉亚提、赛义德·贾利利、莫森·雷扎伊、穆罕默德·加拉齐、哈桑·鲁哈尼和穆罕默德·礼萨·阿雷夫。哈达德-阿德尔和阿雷夫在选举前几天退出竞选。

en.s: The 2016 Democratic Party presidential primaries and caucuses were a series of electoral contests organized by the Democratic Party to select the 4,051 delegates to the Democratic National Convention held July 25–28 and determine the nominee for President of the United States in the 2016 U.S. presidential election. The elections took place within all fifty U.S. states, the District of Columbia, and five U.S. territories and occurred between February 1 and June 14, 2016. An extra 716 unpledged delegates (712 votes) or "superdelegates" are appointed by the Party independently of the primaries' electoral process. The convention will also approve the Party's platform and vice-presidential nominee.

zh.s: 2016年民主党总统初选和党团会议是一系列由民主党组织的选举活动，旨在选出4,051名参加7月25日至28日民主党全国代表大会的代表，并确定该党在2016年美国总统选举中的总统候选人。初选和党团会议于2016年2月1日至6月14日在美国全部50个州、哥伦比亚特区和5个美国属地举行。另有716名未承诺代表（共712票），即“超级代表”，由民主党独立于初选程序任命。代表大会还将通过党纲并提名副总统候选人。

en.s: On 14 June 2017, a high-rise fire broke out in the 24-storey Grenfell Tower block of flats in North Kensington, West London, England, at 00:54 BST and burned for 60 hours. A total of 70 people died at the scene and two other people died later in hospital, with more than 70 injured and 223 escaping.

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Lewisham East was held on 14 June 2018, following the resignation of incumbent Labour Party MP Heidi Alexander. It won by Janet Daby of the Labour with 50.2% of the vote, on a significantly reduced majority for her party.

zh.s: 英国刘易舍姆东区国会议席于2018年6月14日举行补选，起因是原工党议员海蒂·亚历山大辞职。工党的珍妮特·达比以50.2%的得票率获胜，但该党领先优势大幅缩小。

en.t: The 2018 FIFA World Cup opens in Moscow
en.s: On June 14, 2018, the FIFA World Cup opening ceremony took place at Luzhniki Stadium in Moscow, Russia. Robbie Williams and Aida Garifullina performed before the tournament’s opening match between Russia and Saudi Arabia.

zh.t: 2018年足球世界杯在莫斯科开幕
zh.s: 2018年6月14日，足球世界杯开幕式在俄罗斯莫斯科的卢日尼基体育场举行。罗比·威廉斯和阿依达·嘉丽弗莉娜在俄罗斯对沙特阿拉伯的揭幕战前登台表演。

en.s: On June 14, 2020, dozens of Malian soldiers were killed in an ambush perpetrated by the al-Qaeda linked group Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM). The attack was one of the deadliest incidents in recent Malian history, and served as a precursor to the 2020 Malian coup d'état.

zh.s: 2020年6月14日，与基地组织有关联的“伊斯兰与穆斯林支持组织”（JNIM）伏击马里士兵，造成数十名士兵死亡。这是马里近代史上伤亡最惨重的袭击之一，也成为2020年马里政变的前奏。

en.s: The 2020 Backlash was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 15th Backlash and aired on June 14, 2020, with all of the matches taking place at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida. While the majority of the event aired live, the main event was pre-recorded on June 7 and produced as a cinematic match.

zh.s: 2020年Backlash是由WWE制作的职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事，参赛者来自Raw和SmackDown两个主力品牌。赛事是Backlash系列第15届，于2020年6月14日播出，全部比赛都在佛罗里达州奥兰多的WWE训练中心举行。大部分比赛是现场直播，主赛则于6月7日预录，并制作成电影式比赛。

en.s: The 2022 Texas's 34th congressional district special election was held on June 14, 2022. The seat, which went to Democratic president Joe Biden by only four points in the 2020 United States presidential election after being solidly blue in the past, became vacant after Democratic incumbent representative Filemon Vela Jr. resigned on March 31, 2022, to work at the law firm Akin Gump Strauss Hauer & Feld.

zh.s: 2022年德克萨斯州第34国会选区特别选举于2022年6月14日举行。该选区过去一直由民主党稳稳占据，但在2020年美国总统选举中，乔·拜登仅以4个百分点的优势获胜。民主党现任众议员菲莱蒙·维拉二世于2022年3月31日辞职，转而在阿金·冈普律师事务所工作，导致席位出缺。

en.s: The 2022 FIFA World Cup qualification CONCACAF–OFC play-off was a single-leg match between the fourth-placed team of the CONCACAF qualification third round, Costa Rica, and the winners from the OFC qualification, New Zealand. zh.s: 2022年世界杯预选赛中北美及加勒比足联—大洋洲足联附加赛是一场单场决胜赛，由中北美及加勒比足联预选赛第三轮第四名哥斯达黎加对阵大洋洲足联预选赛冠军新西兰。两队胜者的世界杯分组早已确定为E组。比赛于2022年6月14日在卡塔尔赖扬的艾哈迈德·本·阿里体育场举行。

en.s: The 2022 Henderson mayoral election was held on June 14, 2022, to elect the next mayor of Henderson, Nevada. Term-limited incumbent Democratic Mayor Debra March decided to run for the Nevada lieutenant gubernatorial election. Republican Michelle Romero easily won the election. zh.s: 内华达州亨德森市于2022年6月14日举行市长选举。任期届满的民主党现任市长黛布拉·马奇决定参加内华达州副州长选举。共和党人米歇尔·罗梅罗轻松获胜。该选举正式以无党派方式举行。

en.s: The 2022 Fargo mayoral election was held on June 14, 2022. Incumbent mayor Tim Mahoney was re-elected with 40 percent of the approval votes, and was approved of on 64 percent of all ballots. en.s: The Geneina massacre, also the Battle of Geneina, was a series of major battles for control of Geneina, the capital of West Darfur in Sudan, between the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and allied militias against Masalit self-defense militias and the Sudanese Alliance. The battles primarily lasted between April 24 and June 14, 2023, with major attacks and massacres by the RSF and allied militias on Masalit civilians in the city.
